title: Declared Dispatch Registry
description: The divergence dispatch registry (G6: plan/_dispatch.yaml; #1043/#1034). Maps a produced divergence artifact_urn to the train_id that resolves it. The TrainRunner reports a `diverged` result; the Station Master routes by reading this declared registry (it holds no imperative map). A composite (artifact_urn, discriminant) -> train_id key is exceptional - permitted only when that discriminant value's resolution is behaviorally different (the canonical case: commons:decision:escalation.cause).

dispatch.description: Dispatch entries. Each routes a divergence artifact (optionally keyed by one discriminant value) to a resolving train.

artifact_urn.description: The produced divergence artifact URN (the primary that did not match the source step's declaration).

train_id.description: The train that resolves this divergence.

discriminant.description: Composite key: a single {field: value} on the artifact's schema-declared discriminant. Exceptional - requires `behavioral_difference`.

behavioral_difference.description: Required when `discriminant` is present: the real behavioral difference that justifies a composite key (dispatch-composite-key-exceptional).
